protocol.mapping: synthetic six axes are fixed unit-gain offsets from official neutral pose, clipped ±0.35rad
protocol.open_loop_definition: same candidate target, feedforward torque from neutral and target velocity; no q/dq feedback
protocol.primary_rule: all candidate safe/contact; mean tracking<=0.20rad; candidate truth RMSE wins vs zero/shuffled>=60%, vs true open-loop>=80%; state target hashes distinct

limitations: Development adapter prototype, not frozen biological evidence.
Fixed six-channel mapping controls only front-leg pitch DOFs; other36 actuators hold the official neutral pose.
Synthetic truth is used only for scoring and demonstrator command; observer candidate receives frozen89E-derived policy.
No FlyVis, connectome mapping, living animal, muscles, or claim of biological mirror neurons.
